summary: Each reviewed HOLD directory has an exact log output path or a role-owner log path. No formal registration, exact runtime/formal source reference, or matching active process command line was found. Several source-only scouts have no final scientific conclusion; execution status is based only on existing receipts/outputs and is not inferred from code intent. One-off code may be retired while key reports/results remain in log and bulk payloads move to mapped data locations with path/hash receipts. The largest executed pilot loses replay ability if its code is removed, although decision/results and integrity records remain. No HOLD review status changes the original candidate manifest.

preservation_policy_update.log: Key reports, decisions, concise result records, receipts, freezes, manifests, hashes and migration maps stay in log/.
preservation_policy_update.data: Bulk datasets and external source payloads move to corresponding data/ directories per DATA_MIGRATION_PLAN.json; exact nested destinations are controlled by that plan. Old/new paths and hashes remain recorded in log/.
preservation_policy_update.research: Experimental code stays under research/ until validated and promoted; no code is promoted to src/tools in this audit.
preservation_policy_update.source_like_files: The 638 code-like files inventoried under log/ at audit time are primarily external source-code payloads and should migrate as data, not be deleted.
